'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Arvind Bhasker LS Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Arvind Bhasker]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core|Ref3-L-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' ARVIND
* '''Deck name:''' BAD DECK 1
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
